entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I have a problem with my VeloBand. The GPS Tracker one. I'm just so confused by it.
I can certainly help you with that. I'm sorry you're having trouble. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's the pulse thing. The numbers are all over the place. Honestly, the whole thing just feels like garbage. I don't understand why it won't work right.
I understand your frustration. A faulty reading can definitely be concerning. I'd be happy to walk you through a quick sensor recalibration. It often fixes the issue and only takes a moment.
Oh, I... I don't have time for that. I'm not very good with technology. Can't you just help me? I just want my money back. I'd rather just get a refund.
Okay, I understand completely. You don't want to troubleshoot, you'd prefer to return it. Let me pull up your order and check the return eligibility for you. One moment please.
Alright, I have your account here. I see the VeloBand was delivered about 24 days ago, on December 15th. Is that correct?
Yes, that sounds right. Is that okay? I saw something on the website about the policy and got worried.

No reason to worry at all. I'm looking at our policy now, and all VeloFit items can be returned within 90 days of delivery. You are well within that window, so I can definitely process a full refund for you.

I also see on your account that you're a VIP member. I'm very sorry for the trouble this defective band has caused. As a thank you for your loyalty, I've gone ahead and added a $25 credit to your account for any future VeloFit purchase. I'm sending the prepaid return label to your email right now.
Oh! Really? You can do that? That's... that's wonderful. Thank you so much, David. I was so stressed about this.
It's my pleasure to help. The email with the label should be in your inbox now. Simply attach it to the box and drop it off at any post office. Is there anything else I can do for you today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
